patients.name: Marisol
patients.blurb: Moderate, both connections weakened. Many nonwords, some meaning errors. A graduate student and distance runner: aphasia can follow a stroke at any age.

patients.name: Harold
patients.blurb: Severe, phonological. Finds the word, loses its sounds: about half his answers are nonwords. A former machinist.

patients.name: Aisha
patients.blurb: Mild, semantic. Names most pictures; when she errs, a word near in meaning or sound wins. Back at work part-time as an accountant.

patients.name: Kenji
patients.blurb: Severe-moderate, semantic weight the weaker one. A spread of every error type. Keeps a vegetable garden.

patients.name: Ruth
patients.blurb: Moderate-mild, phonological. Nearly every error is a nonword. Sang in a church choir for forty years.

patients.name: Darnell
patients.blurb: Severe, the lowest AQ of the six; both connections weakened. Over half his answers are nonwords; about one in four is right. A paramedic and father of two.
